api/agents.title: Agent APIs Reference
api/agents.description: powermem provides comprehensive multi-agent memory management capabilities.

api/async_memory.title: AsyncMemory API Reference
api/async_memory.description: AsyncMemory provides asynchronous memory operations for high-performance and concurrent scenarios.

api/mcp.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol) API Reference
api/mcp.description: powermem provides an MCP server that exposes memory management capabilities as standardized tools and resources, enabling AI assistants and agents to interact with powermem's memory system through a unified interface.

api/memory.title: Memory API Reference
api/memory.description: Memory is the core synchronous memory management class in powermem. It provides a simple interface for storing, retrieving, and managing memories in LLM applications.

api/overview.title: API Documentation
api/overview.description: This section contains comprehensive API documentation for powermem.

architecture/overview.title: powermem Architecture
architecture/overview.description: powermem is an AI-powered intelligent memory management system that mimics human memory mechanisms to provide persistent memory capabilities for LLM applications. This document provides a comprehensive overview of the system architecture.

benchmark/overview.title: PowerMem Benchmark
benchmark/overview.description: A comprehensive benchmarking suite for PowerMem, including a REST API server for managing memories and a load testing tool based on the LOCOMO dataset.

development/overview.title: Development Guide
development/overview.description: This guide provides comprehensive instructions for developers who want to contribute to PowerMem, including how to set up the development environment, build the project, and add new integrations.

examples/overview.title: Examples
examples/overview.description: This section contains step-by-step examples with code and explanations in interactive Jupyter notebook format.

examples/scenario_1_basic_usage.title: Scenario 1: Basic Usage
examples/scenario_1_basic_usage.description: This scenario guides you through the basics of powermem - storing, retrieving, and managing memories.

examples/scenario_2_intelligent_memory.title: Scenario 2: Intelligent Memory
examples/scenario_2_intelligent_memory.description: This scenario demonstrates powermem's intelligent memory features - automatic fact extraction, duplicate detection, conflict resolution, and more.

examples/scenario_3_multi_agent.title: Scenario 3: Multi-Agent
examples/scenario_3_multi_agent.description: This scenario demonstrates how to use powermem with multiple agents - creating agent-specific memories, cross-agent collaboration, and memory isolation.

examples/scenario_4_async_operations.title: Scenario 4: Async Operations
examples/scenario_4_async_operations.description: This scenario demonstrates how to use powermem's async operations for high-performance, concurrent memory operations.

examples/scenario_5_custom_integration.title: Scenario 5: Custom Integration
examples/scenario_5_custom_integration.description: This scenario demonstrates how to integrate powermem with custom systems, implement custom providers, and extend functionality.

examples/scenario_6_sub_stores.title: Scenario 6: Sub Stores - Memory Partitioning
examples/scenario_6_sub_stores.description: This scenario demonstrates powermem's sub stores feature - partitioning different types of memories into separate storage for more efficient querying and management.

examples/scenario_7_multimodal.title: Scenario 7: Multimodal Capability
examples/scenario_7_multimodal.description: This scenario demonstrates PowerMem's multimodal capability - storing and retrieving images, audio, and other multimedia content.

examples/scenario_8_ebbinghaus_forgettin.title: Scenario 8: Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve
examples/scenario_8_ebbinghaus_forgettin.description: This scenario demonstrates how to implement and utilize the Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve in PowerMem to optimize memory retrieval based on time-based decay patterns.

guides/configuration.description: Complete guide to configuring powermem for different environments and use cases.

guides/custom_prompts_usage.title: Custom Prompts Usage Guide
guides/custom_prompts_usage.description: This guide provides detailed instructions on how to use custom prompts in powermem to customize the behavior of various memory operations.

guides/integrations.description: Guide to integrating powermem with various frameworks and services.

guides/overview.description: Comprehensive guides for using powermem effectively.

guides/sub_stores.description: Complete guide to using sub stores for advanced memory partitioning and optimization.
